browser.scope: Chromium offline set_content. Real local HTML/JS/CSS and image data; explicit memory substitute for localStorage. No HTTP navigation, network iframe, real device or browser persistent-storage certification. Keyboard interaction and document overflow verified.
browser.execution: Local, distinct from CI; captures in delivery report.

features: Distinct contextual success/failure and per-kind completion conditions
Replay-validated contextual checkpoint and two independent local slots
Unique contextual records without campaign rewards
Manual pause, input edge triggers, multi-pointer holds and standard-gamepad mapping
No promotion of experimental profiles into progression
limitations: The 43 exercises use nine abstract state machines, not the CQC physics or original boss scripts.
Trial input frames and thresholds are simulation design, not canon.
Checksums detect corruption; no anti-cheat or transactional tab lock claimed.
Local journal only; no cloud saves.
Per-move final animation, spatial weakpoints and incomplete primary-reference review remain open.
Old contextual checkpoints with incompatible contracts are preserved and rejected rather than silently migrated.
GitHub pull request and Drive archive do not establish production deployment.
